entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'd like to start a return, but I think I might be just outside the typical window, so I was hoping we could work something out.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF77819-B.

Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order from December 15th. I see you have the item. Before we go into the return options, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. To be honest, the interface is just very confusing. I've read the user manual a few times, but I still find it hard to use, especially when I'm trying to track my heart rate zones during a workout. I just expected more from it in terms of ease of use.

I see. I'm sorry to hear the experience wasn't what you were hoping for. When a feature is hard to use, it can definitely take away from the enjoyment. Let me just check the return eligibility for you based on the purchase date.
Alright Alex, I've checked our policy. It looks like you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. No problem at all.

Oh, 10 days? That's fantastic news, I was worried it was only 30. That's a relief. Since I'm going through the process of shipping it back, is there any possibility of a small discount code for a future purchase, just for the inconvenience?

That's a fair question. While our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits on preference-based returns, I can definitely email you a pre-paid shipping label so there's no cost or hassle on your end for the return.
A pre-paid label would be perfect, actually. That solves the issue for me. Thank you, I appreciate you doing that.

You're very welcome. I've just sent that email to you. It has the label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, David.
My pleasure, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
